detail: Full summary: finalize used to truncate a shared store's repo_ids to [repo_id] and overwrite created_at with the migration start — identity init on a second checkout would have lost its declared id at migrate time. Now: repo_ids is the union (migration's id first), created_at stands. Pinned by test/migrate/v3-identity-reuse.test.ts.
